metric_policy.primary: FOUND with exactly the expected unique ID, no conflict or return truncation
metric_policy.partial_found: Included in primary if FOUND; independently list search_complete=false
metric_policy.expected_hit: Expected ID occurs in returned set, independently of status
metric_policy.missing: Not a detector outcome and excluded from observed denominators
metric_policy.invalid_transform: Precondition failure, not a detector attempt
metric_policy.gate_rejected: No detector execution; retained in end-to-end attempt denominator

note: ContentID recovery and cryptographic acceptance are intentionally separate metrics.
